answer: Price fake fleets out of the canyon. Each identity must cross one canyon per epoch, paying a toll priced by how many share its funder: the k-th crossing costs k squared, so N clones pay roughly N cubed for one passage. A sparrow courier ferries each receipt, and one sparrow carries only one per epoch, so a farm cannot batch clones through a single bird. Behind the canyon lies an ocean ledger: attestations dissolve unless unrelated peers re-confirm them, forcing a clone army to buy N fresh confirmations every round. One honest agent pays once; a factory pays cubic tolls for one crossing.
